image_description: A dramatic, steep rock formation rising against a cloudy sky. The central feature is a jagged, vertical cliff face with visible stratification and rough texture. Patches of green vegetation cling to the upper ledges and crevices. To the right, a sloping terrain with reddish-brown earth and sparse grass connects to the main cliff. The lighting suggests daylight with soft shadows, highlighting the rugged surface details.
